page: OVHcloud t2-le-45 is a dedicated hardware-backed virtual instance belonging to the Cloud GPU family. The system operates on the KVM hypervisor and is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6226R processor clocked at 2.9 GHz. It provides 15 dedicated physical cores without simultaneous multithreading, totaling 15 vCPUs. The CPU architecture includes 16 MB of L3 cache, 4 MB of L2 cache, and vector instruction support including AVX-512F and AVX-512 VNNI. System memory measures 45 GB of RAM, allocating 3 GB per core. Acceleration is supplied by a single dedicated NVIDIA Volta V100S GPU with 32 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM.

Local persistent storage is configured with a 300 GB NVMe SSD, delivering high-throughput local scratch space suitable for caching datasets. The instance is provisioned with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default. Across general CPU benchmarks such as Geekbench, stress-ng, and Passmark, the instance consistently scores within the middle 50% tier of comparable cloud hardware, matching standard enterprise server capabilities for x86 compute.

In GPU-accelerated workloads, benchmark results indicate top-tier performance for smaller to medium-scale language models. The NVIDIA V100S GPU delivers 1,434 tokens per second during prompt ingestion and 124.4 tokens per second during generation for 7B parameter models. Larger models exceeding local GPU memory, such as 70B parameter architectures, show substantial throughput drops due to memory constraints. The instance provides an efficient ratio of dedicated compute cores and enterprise accelerator hardware, making it suitable for deep learning model training, AI inference up to medium parameter sizes, GPU-accelerated analytics, and scientific computing simulations.
description: OVHcloud t2-le-45 is an accelerator-focused instance within the Cloud GPU lineup, utilizing KVM virtualization on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6226R processor running at 2.9 GHz. It provisions 15 dedicated vCPUs across 15 physical cores, accompanied by 45 GB of RAM and a single NVIDIA Volta V100S GPU with 32 GB of VRAM. Bundled storage includes a fast 300 GB NVMe SSD alongside a 2 Gbps network baseline. While central processor metrics in stress-ng and Geekbench position the machine within the middle 50% tier, its dedicated V100S achieves top-tier throughput in prompt processing and text generation for medium 7B parameter language models. The balance of 32 GB of high-bandwidth GPU memory and local NVMe storage makes this instance cost-efficient for AI inference, intermediate deep learning workloads, image processing, and scientific computation tasks.
